in_sanskrit.name: कुल्दीप्सिङ्ह

historical_references.reference: According to Hindu mythology, Kuldipsinh was a descendant of the lunar dynasty (Chandravanshi) of the Solar Dynasty (Suryavanshi). He is mentioned in various Hindu texts, including the 'Skanda Purana' and the 'Mahabharata', as a powerful and just king who ruled over a vast territory in present-day Rajasthan and Haryana.
